L001.rule: In scripted file edits, assert each old string matches exactly once and open files with encoding='utf-8'

L002.rule: Use fill(el, ...) instead of el.replaceChildren() in web/assets

L003.rule: Drop deprecated or unpopulated Google API fields in src/gsc.ts before returning responses

L004.rule: After an OAuth code exchange, check the granted scope has every scope the feature needs before saving tokens
